overview: On the sheet the boy has light wings over the wall. She has already refused the moon. A nurse calls Madam from within. The margin holds a hundred and ninety. You did not copy the night out fair.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the lines and the figure, and did not fair-copy them.
